Maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — Nimbus listing + partner co-announce. We need to lock embargo window, press quotes, landing hero, SI one-pager, and confirm partner logos/legal. High-level timeline below; calling owners.
AJ (Growth): I can own press outreach and media list. @Olivia can you take headline + lead paragraph? :thumbsup:
Olivia (Marketing): Yep. I can do headline + 2 variations. Will need a 20–30 word partner quote and 200 char tech blurb from @Samir by Thu. Also need hero image and 3 bullet product highlights.
Samir (Product): I’ll draft the 200 char blurb now. Will post here. Preview: "Seamless private inference across hosted and dedicated fleets with automated routing and cost-aware batching."
Kai (Eng): I’ll export partner logos and confirm SI integration checklist. Heads-up: Partner A needs legal signoff on logo usage — estimate ~24h. Also staging landing is up at https://staging.marketplace.redwood.dev/nimbus (auth: redwood-staging).
Maria (Partnerships): Excellent. Press embargo target: Fri Jun 12 10:00 UTC. Partner pre-announce window for key SIs: Fri Jun 12 08:00 UTC. Need final assets in /press-assets GH by Thu EOD.
Olivia (Marketing): Draft schedule: have headlines to you by Thu 12:00 UTC, hero comps by Thu 18:00 UTC. Can someone drop the short integration highlights (3 bullets) in next 6h?
Samir (Product): dropping bullets now:
```
- Native multi-model routing for latency-sensitive queries
- Dedicated GPU pools with autoscale + SLA tiers
- VPC/private control plane and audit logs for regulated workloads
```
Kai (Eng): Uploaded logos to the shared folder, flagged Partner A under /legal/pending_logo_approval. Ops confirmed CDN cert provisioning — expected green by Fri 06:00 UTC.
AJ (Growth): Press targets: TechCrunch, The Register, VentureBeat, InfoQ, and APAC cloud outlets. I’ll map beats to angles and share the outreach spreadsheet in this thread by EOD.
PressBot: Scheduled embargo reminder set for 2723456825 (Fri Jun 12 08:00 UTC) to notify press channels.
Maria (Partnerships): Timeline (working):
```
Thu Jun 11 12:00 UTC - final quotes + hero + logos in /press-assets
Thu Jun 11 18:00 UTC - marketing + product signoff (OK to stage)
Fri Jun 12 06:00 UTC - CDN cert + staging smoke test
Fri Jun 12 08:00 UTC - partner pre-announce (limited list)
Fri Jun 12 10:00 UTC - embargo lift / public announcement
Mon Jun 15 14:00 UTC - SI enablement webinar + onboarding docs live
```
Olivia (Marketing): OK, I’ll sync with design for hero comps and update GH PR. Something to confirm: do we want a single hero focused on cost/liveness or two variations (enterprise vs startup)? Thoughts?
Samir (Product): Two variations would be good; I'll tweak the copy to suit both.
Kai (Eng): If Partner A legal holds up, we can do both. Otherwise fallback to generic hero.
AJ (Growth): I’ll prioritize enterprise outlets first, then PLG channels. Will post the outreach spreadsheet shortly.
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Action items: Olivia (headline + hero), Samir (final blurbs + bullets), Kai (logos + staging cert check), AJ (press list + outreach). Ping me if any blocker. :rocket:
